{{Top|leg}}
The '''Iblis Globe''' was a sporting venue in [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] that was built by [[44 ABY]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Bazel Warv]], [[Seff Hellin]], and [[Vaala Razelle]]'s cover story for [[Liberation of Coruscant (Lost Tribe of Sith emergence)|arriving]] at Coruscant via the [[Galactic Center Spaceport]]'s [[Arrival Lobby 757]] was to compete in a [[float wrestling]] championship match at the Iblis Globe.<ref name="Apocalypse">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref>
